thread:
deploybot: [SEC-GATE] Artifact rc-2026 (sha256:abc123def...) failed supply-metadata check — missing `provenance.builder_id`. Blocking for current change window.

maria: Heads up — this is blocking our staging rollout. Need a decision: provide missing provenance, accept alternative evidence for staging only, or rollback/pin prod.

alex: I built rc-2026. We do have a cosign signature and timestamped sig artifact in the build bucket. The provenance JSON was not uploaded due to a pipeline step failure. I can attach the cosign sig now.

jamie: Cosign sigs are strong, but policy requires `provenance.builder_id` for prod. For staging we can consider cosign-only if legal ok and security approves a canary carveout. @legal-bot can you weigh in?

legal-bot: Legal: for non-prod (staging) a cosign signature constitutes acceptable chain-of-custody. For prod we still require full provenance. Recommend documented carveout in release notes.

maria: Ok — proposed plan: accept cosign-only evidence for eu-staging canary (30m, 100 hosts), pin prod to rc-2025, require full provenance before any prod promotion.

alex: I attached the cosign sig: `gs://redwood-builds/rc-2026/cosign.sig`. Command to accept: `@deploybot accept-evidence --artifact rc-2026 --type cosign --scope staging`.

deploybot: Evidence attached by alex. Policy check: allowlist `builder_id` missing -> human override required. React with :thumbsup: to accept for staging-only. Reply with `rollback` to pin to previous digest instead.

jamie: :thumbsup: Accepting cosign-only for staging. Also please add a release-note entry: "staging carveout — cosign evidence accepted; prod blocked pending provenance".

maria: I'll update release notes. Also going to pin prod to previous stable: rc-2025. Alex, can you push the pinned digest to release config?

alex: Pinned rc-2025 -> sha256:def456 pushed to `release-config` branch (PR #1347).

deploybot: Pinned digest recorded: prod -> rc-2025 (sha256:def456). Starting staging canary: rc-2026 (cosign-only) to eu-staging. Canary window 30m starting now.

sre-ops-bot: Monitoring hooks added for canary: latency/errors/throughput. Alerts routed to #eng-oncall. No immediate anomalies so far.

jamie: Filed follow-up ticket (#4021) to add provenance upload check to pipeline; assigned to alex. We should also add a unit test to fail the build if provenance missing.

alex: Ack — will open the PR with the pipeline fix and test by EOD tomorrow.

maria: Closing loop here — staging carveout accepted, prod pinned, follow-up to fix pipeline before next change window. Target prod decision: next change window 2026-03-29. Thanks everyone :tada:
